0022600220.text: The Spurs (9-2, 5-0 on the road, on a nine-game winning streak) visit the Bulls (1-8, on a seven-game losing streak), and the teams have not met yet this season. San Antonio won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 129-114 win in San Antonio on March 30, 2026. The Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee, following surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Devin Vassell is day-to-day with a groin injury and a game-time decision. Chicago's Caleb Wilson (hip soreness), Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation), Tobe Awaka (back) and Zach Collins (illness) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions.
